scope: T12 pedagogical fixed-density liquid-drop crust toy

coefficient_set.source_note: Standard educational Bethe-Weizsaecker/Rohlf coefficient set; values are reproduced in public university nuclear-physics teaching notes. They are empirical inputs, not fitted by this package.

conventions.electron_model: provided zero-temperature relativistic ideal electron gas from T11
conventions.objective: minimize total energy per baryon at fixed n_B over an explicitly declared integer A/Z candidate mesh

density_admission_fm3.meaning: pedagogical fully-ionized pre-neutron-drip window, not an exact phase-boundary determination
density_admission_fm3.source_note: Neutron-star crust reviews place neutron drip near 4e11 g cm^-3 and describe nuclei plus a degenerate electron gas below drip; the lower cutoff is a conservative teaching choice near the fully-ionized one-component-plasma regime.
